description: The TileLang tests of vLLM patches 0032-0037 on the sparknet image, from the candidate image's own vLLM tree: pre, post_pre, the first layer's broadcast, post and both collapses against V4.1's FP32 lagged reference; the projection partials and the collapse; results bit-identical across batch sizes. Then the earlier TileLang vocabulary head, router and BF16 projection tests.
